albums.blurb: Kiefer Shackelford is a Los Angeles jazz pianist and beatmaker who studied under Kenny Burrell at UCLA and has lent his playing and production to artists like Anderson .Paak and KAYTRANADA. Happysad, released in June 2018, was his first album for Stones Throw Records, following his 2017 debut Kickinit Alone on Leaving Records. Its thirteen short tracks pair free-flowing jazz piano solos with thumping beat-scene drums, built around the idea that joy and sadness are always intertwined, and the whole record is instrumental.
albums.reception: Bandcamp Daily featured Happysad as an Album of the Day, writing that Kiefer's instrumental piano pieces work beautifully as standalone compositions apart from his work backing rappers and vocalists.

albums.blurb: Juno is the California singer's debut studio album, released on Island Records in October 2021 after the EPs You're a Dog! and I'm Allergic to Dogs! had made her a breakout of the pandemic era. Named after the French bulldog she adopted despite being allergic, it channels a turbulent 2020 in which she entered rehab for alcohol addiction, wrapping that material in maximalist hooks, gloopy grooves, and cartoonish ad-libs that draw on funk, hip-hop, and R&B.
albums.reception: Juno holds a Metacritic score of 85 out of 100 based on twelve reviews, with NME's four-star review calling it "funk-pop at its brightest and boldest."

albums.blurb: Cymande were a South London band of Guyanese and Jamaican musicians whose self-styled "nyah-rock" folded calypso and reggae rhythms from their West Indian roots into American funk and soul. This 1972 debut, released on Janus Records and produced by John Schroeder, was largely ignored in Britain but connected in the United States, and after the band dissolved in the mid-1970s its grooves were rediscovered by hip-hop: De La Soul sampled "Change in Speak" from it, and the Fugees, Wu-Tang Clan, and MC Solaar all mined the band's catalog.
albums.reception: The album reached No. 85 on the Billboard Top LPs chart and No. 24 on the Soul Albums chart, while its single "The Message" hit No. 48 on the Billboard Hot 100.
